name: DJ_Snake
description: Self-hosted Discord music bot: play YouTube or Spotify links in your voice channel, with the video live and in sync on a web page. Automix, web controls, Docker-ready.

paragraphs: A self-hosted Discord music bot that plays YouTube or Spotify links in your voice channel, with a live clip page that shows the video in sync.
Live demo · Project page · Releases · Changelog

This is a self-hosted bot for your own server. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube, Spotify or Discord. It runs on your machine with your own bot token, downloads only the links you give it, and is meant for personal use. Respect YouTube's Terms of Service and the rights of the people whose videos you play. The demo uses Creative Commons footage (credits).
features: Spotify playlists, albums and tracks. Paste a link and the bot finds every song on YouTube, preferring the official music video, with no Spotify account or API key needed (see Spotify links).
YouTube URLs and playlists. Tracks are fully downloaded before they play (no streaming).
Live clip page: muted video synced with the audio, plus web controls (next, previous, pause, resume, seek, jump, remove, reorder, add).
Automix, always on: SponsorBlock musicofftopic segments are cut, loudness is normalised to -14 LUFS, leading and trailing silence is trimmed, and tracks fade in and out.

requirements.text: > This is a self-hosted bot for your own server.
Paste a link and the bot finds every song on YouTube, preferring the official music video, with no Spotify account or API key needed (see Spotify links).
Point POTBASEURL at it, or expect intermittent "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" errors.
"Sign in to confirm you're not a bot": check that pot-provider is healthy (docker compose ps) and that POTBASEURL points at it.
